title: Fano 4-fold quiver moduli from subspace quivers
summary: We classify the moduli spaces of representations of subspace quivers which are Fano fourfolds, under a natural assumption on the dimension vector. These moduli spaces can also be described as GIT quotients of products of Grassmannians by the diagonal action of a projective linear group, and there are exactly four of them. They are rational, of pure Hodge-Tate type, infinitesimally rigid, and have finite automorphism groups, with Picard ranks 5, 6, 6 and 7, making them interesting examples in the classification of Fano fourfolds of large Picard rank, as they are not toric or products.
